name: Make-A-Wish (children's drawings)
description: WestJet 737 MAX 8 C-GWJN (tail 340) in WestJet's standard white and teal with children's drawings in teal along the fuselage and the 'WestJet' title in a crayon-style hand (a Bluesky post, a Flickr title and the maintainer's own sighting). Its date and the drawings' layout are unknown.

sources.title: Transport Canada, Canadian Civil Aircraft Register: C-GWJN
sources.note: Boeing 737-8 registered to WestJet on 2026-02-24 (new that month, as WestJet turned 30); 24-bit address C07FB8. Says nothing of its paint.

sources.title: WestJet: Our history
sources.note: Says WestJet marked its 30th birthday in February 2026 with a 'retro-riffic nod' to its 90s roots; doesn't name an aircraft.

sources.title: A Bluesky post on the livery
sources.note: Evidence only: a 737 MAX 8 for Make-A-Wish, children's drawings in teal and a crayon-style WestJet wordmark.

sources.title: Flickr: C-GWJN WestJet B38M Make-a-Wish Livery
sources.note: Evidence only: names the registration and the scheme.

notes: Described in words only. Named Make-A-Wish by a Bluesky post and a Flickr photo's title (2026-11-23). WestJet's newsroom (to 2026-11-23) has no release on it, Make-A-Wish wish stories don't show it, and Commons has no photo of C-GWJN. The app draws WestJet's standard on it until an open or WestJet press photo shows the drawings.
history: New 2026-11-22, from the lead the maintainer logged.
